what_it_is.prose: Safran Landing Systems is the Safran group's landing-gear business and one of the world's leading makers of aircraft landing gear, wheels and carbon brakes, equipping a large share of commercial and military aircraft globally. Its systems reach India indirectly, fitted to foreign platforms operated in the country — Dassault Rafale fighters, ATR regional turboprops and Airbus airliners among them. However, unlike Safran Aircraft Engines (Hyderabad engine MRO, HAL JVs) or Safran Electrical & Power (Hyderabad plant), Safran's own India press releases and India country page do not describe a dedicated Safran Landing Systems manufacturing plant, MRO shop or joint venture in India; landing-gear support is handled through the broader Safran-group India presence and engineering-services footprint. This dossier is therefore a short Tier C stub: it records that Safran Landing Systems has no distinctly evidenced standalone India footprint in primary sourcing, rather than inferring one from the group's overall expansion.
